simple.summary: יָשֻׁבִי לֶחֶם (Yâshubîy Lechem) means Jashubi-Lechem , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 22.

definitions.usage: Jashubi-lehem. (Prob. the text should be pointed יֹשְׁבֵי לֶחֶם and rendered '(they were) inhabitants of Lechem,' i.e. of Bethlehem (by contraction). Compare 3902 ).
definitions.full: H3433. Yashubi Lechem לָ֑חֶם יָשֻׁ֫בִי proper name, masculine in Judah 1Chr 4:22 ; ᵐ5 L ἐπέστρεψαν εἁυτοῖς Αεεμ .
